tooltips.isUser: True when a CRM user and/or portal user is linked.
tooltips.linkedUser: Optional regular (non-portal) Espo user. Independent from portal user.
tooltips.isOccasional: Occasional volunteer (not a regular weekly commitment).
tooltips.birthProvince: Province of birth (as in the members/volunteers registry).
tooltips.activityCompetences: Shift categories the volunteer is qualified for. Empty = all categories.
tooltips.createCrmUser: After you save, a side panel lets you check the login (username, role, invite link). Uncheck to save the person without a login.

labels.sendPasswordCreateLink: Send the user an email with a link to create a password

messages.fieldNotUniqueAmongContacts: This email is already used by another contact.
messages.fieldNotLegalCombination: These contact types cannot be combined. Allowed pairs: Volunteer + Member, or Employee + Member.
messages.illegalContactTypeCombination: These contact types cannot be combined. Allowed pairs: Volunteer + Member, or Employee + Member.
messages.createCrmUserFailed: The contact was saved, but the CRM user was not created: {error}
messages.createCrmUserNeedsEmail: Add an email before creating a CRM user (needed for the password-setup link).
messages.removeRecordConfirmationContactOnly: This contact is linked to a user. Only the Contact will be deleted — the User account will remain.
messages.removeSelectedRecordsConfirmationContact: At least one selected contact is linked to a user. Only Contact records will be deleted — linked User accounts will remain.
